entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: The state entered by the UE when the attach or combined attach procedure is performed. In this state, the UE behaves according to substates defined in clause 5.2.3.2.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by the UE to register with the network.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by the UE to register with the network, combining EPS and non-EPS services.

relations.description: Performing the attach procedure causes the UE to enter the EMM-REGISTERED state.
Performing the combined attach procedure causes the UE to enter the EMM-REGISTERED state.
